methods.name: LLM-as-a-Judge
methods.description: Using commercial LLMs as surrogates for human evaluators to perform pairwise evaluation on LLM alignment tasks.

methods.name: stratified sampling strategy
methods.description: Sampling strategy employed to ensure that the subset maintains the same proportion of different conditions as the original dataset.

datasets.name: TL;DR Summarization
datasets.description: A common alignment dataset used in experiments to evaluate LLM judges.

datasets.name: HH-RLHF-Helpfulness
datasets.description: A common alignment dataset used in experiments to evaluate LLM judges regarding helpfulness.

metrics.name: Accboth
metrics.description: Accuracy metric evaluated by considering both response orders.

metrics.name: Accrandom
metrics.description: Accuracy metric evaluated by randomly choosing the response order with a probability of 0.5.

metrics.name: Position Bias (PB)
metrics.description: Metric measuring LLM-judge's systematic preference for a specific response position.

metrics.name: Length Bias (LB)
metrics.description: Metric measuring the relative length bias of LLM-judges compared with human evaluators.

concepts.name: LLM alignment
concepts.description: Techniques and tasks like RLHF and DPO used to align LLMs with human preferences.

concepts.name: flipping noise
concepts.description: Discrepancy between the LLM judge's actual decision and its original decision caused by self-inconsistency.

concepts.name: self-inconsistency
concepts.description: Inconsistent judgments produced by LLM judges even when presented with identical prompts, also referred to as system noise.

findings.name: Significant impact of prompt templates
findings.description: Prompt templates have a significant impact on LLM judge performance.

findings.name: Mediocre human alignment
findings.description: There is a mediocre alignment level between the tested LLM judges and human evaluators.
